title: Boone County Planning Commission — homepage Fee Schedule source verification
documentRevisionEvidence: The archived PDF text identifies the fee schedule as revised and adopted May 19, 2021.
evidenceScope: The preserved Boone County Planning Commission homepage directly lists a Fee Schedule link outside the Applications, Forms, and Checklists categories. On 2026-10-02 that exact homepage URL returned HTTP 200 with application/pdf content, and the live 281297-byte file was byte-for-byte identical to the existing archived planning-fee-schedule-2021.pdf with SHA-256 9ed3230d1997a8086a6d9c598aaa0ea34c955b524707ffd58070aea68eb9e49a. This establishes current homepage listing and current source-file identity only. Because the document itself is a 2021 fee schedule, this evidence does not establish that any individual fee amount, threshold, review charge, sign fee, procedure, or applicability rule printed inside it remains current in 2026.
